description: Defines the RequestedLayerState struct which manages client-requested states for a layer in the Android surfaceflinger frontend, including state changes, properties, and relationships.

classes.name: RequestedLayerState
classes.description: Stores client requested states for a layer, including properties, state changes, and relationships within the surfaceflinger frontend.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces a rectangle by excluding a region.

methods.name: RequestedLayerState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layer state with creation arguments.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges new state into the current layer state.

methods.name: clearChanges
methods.description: Clears the recorded state changes.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Returns the transform applied to the layer based on display rotation flags.

methods.name: getUnrotatedBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size without rotation.

methods.name: canBeDestroyed

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the layer is a root layer.

methods.name: isHiddenByPolicy

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color of the layer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size considering display rotation.

methods.name: getCroppedBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the cropped buffer size.

methods.name: getBufferCrop
methods.description: Returns the buffer crop rectangle.

methods.name: getDebugString

methods.description: Provides a short debug string of the layer state.

methods.name: getCompositionType
methods.description: Returns the composition type of the layer.

methods.name: hasValidRelativeParent

methods.name: hasInputInfo
methods.description: Checks if the layer has input information.

methods.name: hasBlur

methods.name: hasFrameUpdate

methods.name: hasReadyFrame

methods.name: hasSidebandStreamFrame
